speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that initial detail. To better understand your condition, could you describe exactly what the swelling feels like and if you've experienced any pain or stiffness in that knee? Additionally, have you noticed similar symptoms in any other joints or family members?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A.

Based on the patient's age, spontaneous right knee swelling without trauma, and a familial history of similar issues, this presentation is highly suggestive of a bleeding disorder. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with Platelet Count. REQUEST TEST: Prothrombin Time (PT) and Partial Thromboplastin Time (PTT). REQUEST IMAGES: Right Knee X-Ray to rule out fracture or severe hemarthrosis.
